verdict.rationale: Modal's docs and probes confirm Sandboxes are provisioned programmatically via SDK/CLI with fast, isolated, ephemeral environments ('spin up fresh, isolated sandboxes programmatically', 'hundreds of thousands of concurrent rollout environments in seconds'), and community builders (GitHub Actions runners, JS agent runtime) corroborate real one-call sandbox spin-up in practice. Missing for 10: independent latency benchmarks confirming 'seconds' claim and a concrete single-call code snippet in the evidence pack.
